# AndroidX Material icon artwork

Six unmodified Kotlin vector definitions from AndroidX Compose Material Icons
Extended 1.7.8: Brush, ChevronLeft, DeleteOutline, FileDownload, FolderOpen, VolumeUp.
Original copyright and Apache 2.0 headers are retained in every file.
Other icons continue to come from material-icons-core.

Source: https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/androidx/compose/material/material-icons-extended-android/1.7.8/material-icons-extended-android-1.7.8-sources.jar
Source archive SHA-256: 77b7e782a519a3e074fc91e09d59334ac1b815edd87d2e89c0c9ca7c95678e93

These exact existing vectors replace the complete extended icon dependency,
without changing the artwork or importing unused icon families.
